title: The router broad-lookups probe asks each kind expert's own phrasings, so a narrowed cue that drops a common phrasing fails at its landing
goal: the router_broad_lookups probe in test_live_kb.py asks, for each kind expert, a set of its own phrasings built from the kb (cites: mention, refer, name and cite with 'the source', 'source id' or nothing between the word and an id the kb cites) and fails naming each that does not route to its expert (SP-lmf4ke4w retrospective: BG-hc2gficq narrowed kbfacts.CITE_CUE and its checks tried only bare forms such as mention S1800, so 'Which articles mention the source S1800?' lost the cites route and the review found it as S1, BG-subz6cnf)
notes: Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 2 of 15, "Pack notes, router cost and query-log apply guards read what they should"): it serves the fitness tests of EP-gzr4mmkm: a lookup's verdict or the benchmark's measurement is wrong until it is fixed. Premise: kbfacts.routed answers the cites phrasings of S1800 today, and no probe asks them. Run 2026-10-13 on the base: the six phrasings (mention the source, mention source, mention, refer to the source ID, cite the source, names the source id) all route to cites; the check's selector collects no test, so tests.py exits 2 (precheck). Test-only unless a phrasing the probe builds fails: then kbfacts.py is the fix. The probe extends the router_broad_lookups test or adds one id inside the ceiling; the ceiling is the operator's and no gate edits it. Follows BG-s7du27qb.
